'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023-present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Twelve-Day War]]
***[[List of attacks during the Twelve-Day War#Operation Rising Lion|Airstrikes during the Twelve-Day War]]
****A [[United Nations]] fact-finding mission reports that [[Israel]]i strikes on [[Iran]]’s [[Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting|state broadcasting agency]] and killing of Iranian [[nuclear scientist]]s were likely in violation of [[international humanitarian law]]. [https://aje.io/j5j5ww?update=3795089 (Al Jazeera)] 
****The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] strikes [[Evin Prison]] in [[Tehran]], [[Iran]], damaging the facility's infrastructure. State TV showed [[first responders]] carrying a casualty and searching for survivors under a collapsed building. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp8621gnknjo (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-weighs-retaliation-against-us-strikes-nuclear-sites-2025-06-23/ (Reuters)]
****[[Qatar]] closes the country's [[airspace]] amidst an imminent threat of a [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian]] [[ballistic missile]] attack on [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] stationed in the country. Multiple explosions are reported over [[Doha]]. [https://apnews.com/live/iran-israel-war-updates-6-23-2025 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cn7ze4vmk2pt (BBC News)]
***[[2025 Iranian strikes on Al Udeid Air Base]]
****Iran's [[Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps]] says it has launched missiles at the U.S. [[Al Udeid Air Base]] in [[Qatar]] and U.S. bases in [[Iraq]]. U.S. officials later confirm no Iranian missiles hit the Al Udeid Air Base. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20250623-live-trump-says-strikes-on-iran-inflicted-monumental-damage-to-tehran-s-nuclear-program (France 24)]
****The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Qatar)|Qatar Foreign Ministry]] says the [[Qatar Armed Forces|Qatari military]] has intercepted all the missiles launched at the Al Udeid Air Base, and that no injuries are reported. [https://www.albawaba.com/news/qatar-intercepts-iranian-missile-strike-1607353 (Al Bawaba)] [https://www.axios.com/2025/06/23/iran-retaliation-trump-israel-war (Axios)]
***[[Twelve-Day War ceasefire]]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that a ceasefire has been reached between Iran and Israel. The ceasefire has not been confirmed by either Iran or Israel. [https://aje.io/7jaly7 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/trump-says-iran-israel-agree-ceasefire-2025-06-23/ (Reuters)]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Rafah aid distribution killings]]
****[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] gunfire and airstrikes kill at least 43 [[Palestinians]] across the [[Gaza Strip]], including 13 people seeking [[Humanitarian aid during the Gaza war|aid assistance]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/23/israel-kills-at-least-30-palestinians-in-gaza-including-aid-seekers (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Spain|Spanish]] [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Spain)|foreign minister]] [[José Manuel Albares|José Albares]] calls on the [[European Council]] to suspend [[Israel–European Union relations|EU relations with Israel]] due to Israeli [[human rights violation]]s in Gaza. He also calls for an [[arms embargo]] against Israel and [[international sanctions|sanctions]] on individuals obstructing the [[two-state solution]]. [https://aje.io/j5j5ww?update=3794000 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/spanish-foreign-minister-calls-for-suspension-of-eu-israel-association-agreement-arms-embargo-3703863 (YeniSafak)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***At least seven [[Ugandan Armed Forces]] personnel are confirmed killed by [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al Shabaab]] following a three-day siege on Sabiidd-Anole in the [[Lower Shabelle]] region of [[Somalia]] amid ongoing operations against the militant group. The soldiers were part of the [[African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia]], tasked with countering Al-Shabaab. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/seven-ugandan-soldiers-killed-in-fierce-battle-to-retake-somali-town-from-al-shabaab (Garowe Online)] [https://thedefensepost.com/2025/06/23/somalia-al-shabaab-uganda-army/ (''The Defense Post'')]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] claims that its fighters have overrun a military installation, killed several soldiers, and seized weapons and military equipment following fierce fighting erupted on the morning between [[Somali National Army]] and Al-Shabaab militants. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Jun/201965/heavy_fighting_erupts_near_baidoa_as_al_shabab_attacks_military_base.aspx (Hiiraan Online)] [https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/somalia%20al%20shabaab/168882/clashes-between-somali-forces-al-shabaab-erupt-near-baidoa-after-attack-on-military-base (''The Eastleigh Voice'')]
**[[Child soldiers in Somalia]]
***The [[United Nations]] formally removes [[Somalia]] from its annual register of nations that enlist and deploy [[child soldiers]]. The country had been included on the register since 2007, owing to consistent reports of child recruitment by [[Somali Armed Forces]] and associated militias. [https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/somalia%252520un%252520blacklist/168763/un-delists-somalia-from-child-soldier-report-after-16-years-in-major-reform-milestone?amp=1 (''The Eastleigh Voice'')] [https://childrenandarmedconflict.un.org/2025/06/22495-haunting-cries-children-affected-by-conflict-endured-an-unconscionable-number-of-grave-violations-in-2024/ (UN)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[NATO]] [[Secretary General of NATO|Secretary-General]] [[Mark Rutte]] announces that [[European Union|European countries]] and [[Canada]] will send [[Ukraine]] a combined aid package of {{Euro}}35 billion (US$40.3 billion). [https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/nato-chief-ukraine-to-receive-over-35-billion-1750690298.html (RBC)]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch a large-scale [[drone warfare|drone]] and missile strike on [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], damaging residential areas, hospitals, and sports infrastructure, killing nine people and injuring at least 33 others. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0k7vll16l3o (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Gaza war protests]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] announces it will ban the [[direct action]] protest network [[Palestine Action]] on [[Terrorism Acts|anti-terrorism]] grounds after the group broke into the [[RAF Brize Norton]] base and vandalized two planes. [https://apnews.com/article/uk-ban-palestine-action-967a0080ffa855465cc7049e8fa17aac (AP)]
*The [[Department of Special Investigation|Thai Department of Special Investigation]] seizes 2.4 metric tons of [[methamphetamine]] disguised as [[maize flour|corn flour]] packages worth $90.8 million from a tourist boat off the coast of [[Eastern Thailand|Eastern]] [[Thailand]] and arrests eight men in [[Rayong province]] for attempted [[drug smuggling]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-methamphetamine-seizure-drugs-b3b0ead895ec66dcbd201881b04f7087 (AP)]
*The [[Indonesia]]n [[National Narcotics Board]] announces it arrested 285 people, including 29 women and seven foreigners, and seized over 0.68 ton of [[narcotics]] in a two-month crackdown operation on narcotrafficking and [[illegal drug abuse]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-drug-traffickers-arrest-crackdown-3327395b5cb0a45d9a628bfefa337daa (AP)]
